tagline: Plain-Language Medical Report and Prescription Explainer

disclaimer.title: Medical Safety Notice
disclaimer.body: ReportSaathi provides educational explanations of medical documents. It does not diagnose diseases, prescribe medicines or replace professional medical advice. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical decisions.

hero.title: Understand Your Medical Reports in Simple Words
hero.subtitle: Clear, friendly, and non-diagnostic explanations of complex lab results, prescription abbreviations, and hospital discharge summaries in English, Kannada, and Hindi.

howItWorks.title: How ReportSaathi Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps to transform complex clinical documents into understandable insights.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Upload a digital PDF, scan, or photo of your lab report, prescription, or discharge summary.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our engine extracts printed values, compares lab ranges, and simplifies terminology in your chosen language.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Receive tailored, helpful questions to ask your physician during your next clinical visit.

supportedDocs.title: Documents We Help You Understand
supportedDocs.subtitle: Designed specifically for everyday healthcare documents you receive from clinics and hospitals.
supportedDocs.labDesc: Blood tests, urine tests, lipid panels, and CBCs. We explain what each test measures and highlight whether results are within the printed lab reference range.
supportedDocs.rxDesc: Clarifies dosage schedules, food timing (before/after meals), and medical abbreviations without ever modifying or suggesting medications.
supportedDocs.dischargeDesc: Translates hospital course summaries, discharge instructions, and follow-up precautions into clear, actionable everyday language.

features.title: Built with Empathy and Safety First
features.subtitle: Every feature is engineered to protect patient well-being while eliminating confusing terminology.
features.f1Desc: Translates complex clinical terms into 6th-grade reading level explanations without losing accuracy.
features.f2Desc: Uses only the reference ranges printed on your specific laboratory slip. Never invents thresholds.
features.f3Desc: Seamlessly switch between English, ಕನ್ನಡ (Kannada), and हिन्दी (Hindi) with authentic native phrasing.
features.f4Desc: Your health documents are kept strictly private, encrypted, and are never shared or indexed.

safety.title: Why Medical Safety is Our Top Priority
safety.subtitle: ReportSaathi is strictly an educational explainer, never an automated physician or prescribing engine.
safety.neverDiagnoseDesc: We explain what a test means, but we never tell you that you have a disease or condition.
safety.neverPrescribeDesc: We clarify how your doctor wrote the prescription. We never alter dosages or recommend drugs.
safety.groundedDesc: If handwriting or values are unclear, we highlight the uncertainty and advise asking your pharmacist.
safety.doctorQuestionsDesc: Our goal is to prepare you for informed, confident conversations with your treating healthcare provider.

interactivePreview.title: See the Difference: Jargon vs Plain Language
interactivePreview.subtitle: Here is an example of how ReportSaathi breaks down a typical complete blood count (CBC) entry.
interactivePreview.simpleExplain: Hemoglobin is the protein inside your red blood cells that carries oxygen from your lungs to the rest of your body.
interactivePreview.rangeNote: Your reported value (10.2 g/dL) is below this laboratory's reference range (12.0 - 15.5 g/dL).
interactivePreview.suggestedQuestion: Suggested Question for Doctor: 'What could be contributing to my lower hemoglobin level, and do I need dietary changes or further tests?'

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Can ReportSaathi tell me if I have a disease?
faq.a1: No. ReportSaathi is strictly an educational tool. It explains what your tests measure and what the numbers mean, but clinical diagnosis can only be made by a licensed healthcare professional considering your full physical examination and history.
faq.q2: Are my uploaded medical documents stored securely?
faq.a2: Yes. Documents are stored in protected, private storage accessible only by your authenticated account. They are never publicly reachable via web links.
faq.q3: Does the app support Kannada and Hindi?
faq.a3: Yes! Full interface and explanation translations are supported in English, Kannada (ಕನ್ನಡ), and Hindi (हिन्दी) with culturally natural medical terms.

extraction.title: Document Text Extraction & Patient Review
extraction.subtitle: Carefully review the text and numbers extracted from your medical document. You can correct any OCR mistakes before plain-language explanation.
extraction.confidenceNotice: Confidence measures optical text legibility, NOT clinical correctness or diagnosis.
extraction.ocrMissingNotice: This document appears to be scanned or image-based, but local Tesseract OCR binary is not installed on this server. Automatic text extraction could not proceed locally.
extraction.geminiConsentNotice: External AI Vision processing is disabled by default to protect patient privacy.
extraction.uncertaintyBannerTitle: Uncertainty or Missing Printed Values Detected
extraction.uncertaintyBannerDesc: Some numbers or reference ranges could not be found printed on the document or appear ambiguous. Please review the highlighted rows.
extraction.reviewConfirmedSuccess: Patient review recorded successfully! Document is verified and ready for plain-language explanation.
extraction.stage5Notice: Stage 5 (Gemini Plain-Language Medical Explanations) is scheduled next and will be unlocked once approved.
extraction.emptyItems: No structured test or prescription items were detected. You may inspect the raw text below.
